vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 Senate votes, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 13. Nay or No: 27. Not Voting: 0. said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.
